roadmap.title: Road to 1.0
roadmap.measure: Acceptance points delivered across Theandril’s own published roadmap catalogue — each item’s record of what it has shipped and what it still owes.
roadmap.source_label: The published roadmap and its evidence
roadmap.note: 6 of 23 catalogue items are complete and all 15 release gates remain open. Published rules/save 31 includes finite fleet supplies and group land-army postings. Acceptance-point totals are recomputed from the current published delivered/remaining catalogue bullets; editorial regrouping changes this count, so it is not a fixed-scope completion percentage or release acceptance.

milestones.title: Stabilize the campaign and close the current AI findings
milestones.detail: Every retained campaign-safety scenario passes against the rules that ship, including the pending-assault regression that had been frozen at rules 17. The wider gates behind M0 are still open.

milestones.title: Client states and unification victory
milestones.detail: A contestable two-thirds Unification bid is playable, city-states seat beside the realms, and a realm may take another as its paid client whose hearths stand behind its bid. Client capture outcomes and transfers between patron and client remain.

milestones.title: A complete magical discovery loop
milestones.detail: Seams are hidden under Ashfall glass, found by a paid survey, drawn for ashglass and required before Arcane Theory; Unbinding answers a working with a working and costs its caster a round. Reactive interception and personal path growth remain.

milestones.title: Empire delegation and coordinated orders
milestones.detail: Standing charters, muster points, army postings and cause-grouped alerts exist. Players now select up to 128 land armies ashore across pages/search and apply Hold/Join or clear postings through ordinary commands with one worker response. Partial refusals, individual overrides,100-army/40-hearth save/load and keyboard/narrow controls are verified. Theater strategy, patrol/escort roles, named groups and broader order/policy templates remain.

milestones.title: Supply, trade and sustained military operations
milestones.detail: Land, depot and harbor supply plus finite fleet provisions are published under rules/save 31. Fleets carry eight turns of stores, passengers share shortages and AI plans visible returns/refills and paid staging harbors. Epic 379 fits 350-400; Long 342 and Standard 234 remain above approximate 300/200 targets. Material costs, trade routes, taxation, treaty access, coordinated operations and broader recovery remain.

milestones.title: Independent powers, political pressure and agent roles
milestones.detail: Twenty-four city-states are authored, playable and courtable as clients. Clans, pirates, mercenaries, enclaves and the political layer are not built.

milestones.title: Epochs, crises and the living campaign
milestones.detail: Navigate eras, upheaval and world crises rather than a flat timeline.

milestones.title: Progression depth and the third victory path
milestones.detail: Two victory paths exist; the third and the deeper progression behind it do not.

milestones.title: Authored breadth, exploration and final presentation
milestones.detail: Twenty-four cultures, seven map types and the city-state register are published; the quantitative content and art targets are not met.

milestones.title: Authoritative online campaigns
milestones.detail: The deployed game is single-player; no server, rooms or reconnect exist.

milestones.title: Sustained proof and release signoff
milestones.detail: Prove the integrated release at scale and across browsers, then sign the gates.
